It summarizes significant within-person (daily) and between-person (weekly) interactions: higher daily frequency of body-focused interactions predicted poorer outcomes on low-self-compassion days but reversed or attenuated on high-self-compassion days; at the between-person level, higher mean frequency predicted lower intuitive eating and body appreciation for low/average self-compassion but not for high self-compassion. The section does not label multiple studies (no 'Study 1' etc.).
